import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from scipy import stats

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv')

# Display column info
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nData shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for missing values in the three columns of interest
print("\nMissing values:")
print(df[['price', 'area', 'bathrooms']].isnull().sum())

# Filter rows without missing values in price, area, and bathrooms
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['price', 'area', 'bathrooms'])
print(f"\nClean dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}")

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df_clean[['area', 'bathrooms']]
y = df_clean['price']

# Fit the multiple linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get coefficients and intercept
print("\nModel coefficients:")
print(f"Area coefficient: {model.coef_[0]}")
print(f"Bathrooms coefficient: {model.coef_[1]}")
print(f"Intercept: {model.intercept_}")

# Get predictions and calculate R-squared
y_pred = model.predict(X)
ss_res = ((y - y_pred) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y - y.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
print(f"\nR-squared value: {r_squared}")

# Perform t-tests to get p-values for each predictor
# For each coefficient, we need to calculate the standard error
n = len(y)
p = X.shape[1]

# Calculate residuals
residuals = y - y_pred

# Calculate residual variance (MSE)
mse = ss_res / (n - p - 1)

# Calculate X'X matrix
X_matrix = X.values
xtx = X_matrix.T @ X_matrix

# Invert X'X
xtx_inv = np.linalg.inv(xtx)

# Standard errors of coefficients
std_errors = np.sqrt(mse * np.diag(xtx_inv))

print(f"\nStandard errors: {std_errors}")

# Calculate t-statistics
t_stats = model.coef_ / std_errors
print(f"t-statistics: {t_stats}")

# Calculate p-values (two-tailed test)
p_values = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_stats), df=n - p - 1))
print(f"P-values: {p_values}")

# Determine significance at alpha = 0.05
alpha = 0.05
area_significant = p_values[0] < alpha
bathrooms_significant = p_values[1] < alpha

print(f"\nSignificance level: {alpha}")
print(f"Area significant (p < {alpha}): {area_significant} (p-value = {p_values[0]:.6f})")
print(f"Bathrooms significant (p < {alpha}): {bathrooms_significant} (p-value = {p_values[1]:.6f})")

# Format the output
area_sig = "yes" if area_significant else "no"
bathrooms_sig = "yes" if bathrooms_significant else "no"
r_squared_formatted = f"{r_squared:.4f}"

print(f"\n--- FINAL OUTPUT ---")
print(f"@significant_predictor[{area_sig},{bathrooms_sig}] @r_squared[{r_squared_formatted}]")
